@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+"""Standalone, warning-free variant of pytest's legacy hook mark parsing.
+
+Mirrors ``_pytest.config._get_legacy_hook_marks`` but never emits the
+legacy-marking deprecation warning, so it can be imported without pytest's
+configuration or warning infrastructure.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+
+__all__ = ["silent_legacy_hook_marks"]
+
+
+def silent_legacy_hook_marks(
+    method: Any,
+    hook_type: str,
+    opt_names: tuple[str, ...],
+) -> dict[str, bool]:
+    """Return the legacy hook options set on ``method`` as a dict of booleans.
+
+    An option is ``True`` if ``method`` has an attribute of that name (whatever
+    its value) or carries a ``pytestmark`` mark of that name; otherwise it is
+    ``False``. ``hook_type`` is accepted for signature compatibility only.
+    """
+    known_marks: set[str] = {m.name for m in getattr(method, "pytestmark", [])}
+    opts: dict[str, bool] = {}
+    for opt_name in opt_names:
+        opt_attr = getattr(method, opt_name, AttributeError)
+        if opt_attr is not AttributeError:
+            opts[opt_name] = True
+        elif opt_name in known_marks:
+            opts[opt_name] = True
+        else:
+            opts[opt_name] = False
+    return opts
diff --git a/testing/test_standalone_silent_legacy_hooks.py b/testing/test_standalone_silent_legacy_hooks.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..c01e54582
--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_standalone_silent_legacy_hooks.py
@@ -0,0 +1,131 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import ModuleType
+import warnings
+
+import pytest
+
+
+def _load_module() -> ModuleType:
+    path = (
+        Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_silent_legacy_hooks.py"
+    )
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_silent_legacy_hooks", path
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+silent_legacy_hook_marks = _load_module().silent_legacy_hook_marks
+
+IMPL_OPTS = ("tryfirst", "trylast", "optionalhook", "hookwrapper")
+
+
+class _Mark:
+    def __init__(self, name: str) -> None:
+        self.name = name
+
+
+def test_no_marks_all_false() -> None:
+    def hook() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    assert silent_legacy_hook_marks(hook, "impl", IMPL_OPTS) == dict.fromkeys(
+        IMPL_OPTS, False
+    )
+
+
+def test_empty_opt_names() -> None:
+    def hook() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    hook.tryfirst = True  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    assert silent_legacy_hook_marks(hook, "impl", ()) == {}
+
+
+def test_attribute_sets_true_even_if_falsy() -> None:
+    def hook() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    hook.tryfirst = False  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    hook.hookwrapper = None  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    assert silent_legacy_hook_marks(hook, "impl", IMPL_OPTS) == {
+        "tryfirst": True,
+        "trylast": False,
+        "optionalhook": False,
+        "hookwrapper": True,
+    }
+
+
+def test_pytestmark_names() -> None:
+    def hook() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    hook.pytestmark = [_Mark("firstresult")]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    assert silent_legacy_hook_marks(hook, "spec", ("firstresult", "historic")) == {
+        "firstresult": True,
+        "historic": False,
+    }
+
+
+def test_real_pytest_marks() -> None:
+    @pytest.mark.trylast
+    def hook() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    result = silent_legacy_hook_marks(hook, "impl", IMPL_OPTS)
+    assert result["trylast"] is True
+    assert result["tryfirst"] is False
+
+
+def test_attribute_and_mark_combined() -> None:
+    def hook() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    hook.historic = 0  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    hook.pytestmark = [_Mark("historic"), _Mark("firstresult")]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    assert silent_legacy_hook_marks(hook, "spec", ("firstresult", "historic")) == {
+        "firstresult": True,
+        "historic": True,
+    }
+
+
+def test_emits_no_warning() -> None:
+    def hook() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    hook.tryfirst = True  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    hook.pytestmark = [_Mark("trylast")]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    with warnings.catch_warnings():
+        warnings.simplefilter("error")
+        result = silent_legacy_hook_marks(hook, "impl", IMPL_OPTS)
+    assert result["tryfirst"] is True
+    assert result["trylast"] is True
+
+
+def test_invalid_pytestmark_raises() -> None:
+    def hook() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    hook.pytestmark = [object()]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
+        silent_legacy_hook_marks(hook, "impl", IMPL_OPTS)
+
+
+def test_matches_reference_values() -> None:
+    from _pytest.config import _get_legacy_hook_marks
+
+    def hook() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    hook.optionalhook = ""  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    hook.pytestmark = [_Mark("hookwrapper")]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    with warnings.catch_warnings():
+        warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
+        expected = _get_legacy_hook_marks(hook, "impl", IMPL_OPTS)
+    assert silent_legacy_hook_marks(hook, "impl", IMPL_OPTS) == expected
notes:
Copied _get_legacy_hook_marks control flow into a stdlib-only module, dropping only the must_warn collection and warning emission; tests load it by file path and compare against the reference.
